name: Ichinohe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ichinohe town emblem in white: a ring above a small stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Ichinohe, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in October 1958.

features.role: Ichinohe town emblem — a ring above a small stylised device
